author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
In Reply to Rylee's Writing Challenge

I fired up Sirius radio and the dial already sat on Phish Radio, playing Camel Walk

Goin' downtown to the disco
Gotta do it right away
Gotta funky thing to get into
Gonna blow my blues away

No great literay anaylsis here as the song, which I love, captures is soul in the space between notes rather than the meaning of words.

Yet the one real verse captures why I love when I get to see the song live. The juxtaposition of funk to chase away the blues is a neat little play on words as both can be emotions and sound.

Yet to me when I get to hear Camel Walk it means the band came to throw down the funk.

Sometimes I need it. You just gotta dance.
